label: Location and interaction
text: EA.O.A5.1 Location and interaction. Site and situation; absolute and relative location. Distance decay is the claim that interaction falls with distance, modified by origin and destination size. It is owned here. Gravity-model estimation is EA.M.5. In trade, the gravity equation has structural derivations (Anderson 1979; Anderson and van Wincoop 2003); that derivation is EC. In migration, gravity models are mostly reduced-form. CONTESTED for migration.
